author: CNET
description:
Three students from Harvard invented a wearable headset, Rumble Rims, that can help coaches screen student athletes for possible concussions.

It’s a “low-cost infrared eye-tracking headset” that takes around 60 seconds to conduct the test and give guidance if there is a “concussion-related neurological disruption.”

This invention earned Radhika Saran, Cleo Pontone, and Sophia DeVito the James Dyson Award to help develop this device that could help millions of students. Here’s how the device works. #concussion #headset #invention #dyson #studentathlete
